name: @netrunner714/pegas
description: Bun-native, agent-first zero-config L7 reverse proxy orchestrator for Docker

scripts.build: bun scripts/gen-example.ts && bun scripts/gen-docs.ts && bun build src/index.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/index.js && bun build src/runtime-sdk.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/runtime.js && tsc -p tsconfig.declarations.json && mv dist/runtime-sdk.d.ts dist/runtime.d.ts && rm -rf dist/src && chmod +x dist/index.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run docs:check && bun run build

author: NETRUNNER714 <admin@netrunner714.ru>
